title: Incorporate a company
description: SECP company incorporation. No link is shown until the official address is confirmed.

questions.prompt_ru: Kya naam reserve ho chuka hai?

steps.title: Read the Companies Act provision
steps.detail: Incorporation is under the Companies Act, 2017. Reserve the name before the incorporation forms if it is not reserved yet.
steps.detail_ru: Incorporation Companies Act, 2017 ke tehat hai. Agar naam abhi reserve nahi hua to incorporation forms se pehle naam reserve karein.

steps.title: File on SECP eServices
steps.detail: Use the official SECP eServices portal. This build does not show a URL because the registration address is not confirmed here.
steps.detail_ru: Official SECP eServices portal istemal karein. Yeh build URL nahi dikhati kyunke registration ka pata yahan confirmed nahi.
